description: Defines data models for recipes, including Recipe, Ingredient, and Step classes, as well as a Categories object for categorization.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: A data class representing a recipe with id, title, description, category, imageUrl, ingredients, and steps.

classes.name: Ingredient
classes.description: A data class representing an ingredient with name and quantity.

classes.name: Step
classes.description: A data class representing a cooking step with index and instruction.
